subject.title: [Feature]: Auto‑forward images from Node agent.request to IM users when deliver: true

question: Should OpenClaw add an explicit opt-in `agent.request` media relay contract that can forward Node-originated attachments to chat, or should media delivery remain controlled by direct send and agent-authored reply/message-tool payloads?
rationale: The requested behavior is useful but changes who is allowed to move media from a Node event across credentialed IM delivery, so automation cannot safely choose the product/security boundary.

options.title: Design explicit opt-in relay
options.body: Add a new protocol/API contract only after defining authorization, target scoping, media limits, audit, and agent override semantics.

options.title: Keep agent-controlled delivery
options.body: Leave request attachments as model input and require Node callers to use direct send or the agent/message tool for visible media delivery.

options.title: Defer to transcript work only
options.body: Treat the open transcript PR as adjacent state repair and leave auto-forwarding for a separate sponsored design.

recommendation.title: Design explicit opt-in relay
recommendation.body: Add a new protocol/API contract only after defining authorization, target scoping, media limits, audit, and agent override semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a gateway/media security-boundary product choice, and `steipete` is the strongest available routing candidate from recent area history plus parser ownership signals.
